definitions: Making a desperate attempt to find support or a solution even when there is little hope or evidence of success.
Trying to find any possible option, no matter how unlikely, in a difficult situation.
examples: He was grasping at straws, trying to blame anyone else for his mistakes.
The company's latest marketing strategy feels like grasping at straws to save their failing product.
In her panic, she was grasping at straws, suggesting increasingly absurd solutions.
